_source: OpenRouter /api/v1/models/<id>/endpoints, fetched 2026-10-30. USD per 1M tokens. OpenRouter bills inference at the provider's listed price (no markup) and charges 5.5% when credits are purchased (Standard plan). Re-check on the run date; the call log stores the provider-reported cost of every call.

_pinning_rationale.M1: Two fp8 endpoints exist. GMICloud is pinned: same weights, and its rate is the higher of the two, so estimates made with the pinned rate are not optimistic. Fallbacks are disabled, so a provider outage halts the run instead of silently switching hosts.
_pinning_rationale.M2: DeepInfra: the endpoint with a recorded 100% recent uptime at the standard rate (GMICloud showed no uptime figure).
_pinning_rationale.G: OpenAI first-party: Azure announced GPT-4.1 (2025-04-14) deprecation on 2026-11-04; OpenAI's API removal is 2027-01-14, after the study window.
